mechanics.summary: Magmaw is immobile and the tank keeps it in melee; current guides require melee access.
Repository removes vehicle occupants and randomly resizes the target list by raid size.
conflicts: Wowhead prose says 3/8 players ‘in heroic difficulty’, while repository and size-based Icy reading are 10/25; use repository size rule only.
Wowhead narrative damage and ability-table range do not establish a mode mapping.

mechanics.summary: Raid-wide fire event; current guides describe a six-second sequence and the repository schedules it separately from projectile events.
conflicts: Guide interval and repository event interval differ; exact Classic cadence and mode scaling are unresolved.

mechanics.summary: Pillar selects a non-vehicle target and prefers targets beyond 15 yards when available; target should leave the marker before impact.
conflicts: A reliable mode-by-mode damage/spawn table was not found; the hotfix is original Cataclysm context and Classic carryover is not proven.

mechanics.summary: Pillar creates parasites; infection damage/vomit and parasite target limits are represented in the repository, but the exact live spawn count is not.

values.guide_spawn_count: up to 7 (Wowhead); conflicting old Icy material reports 9
values.infection_damage: 25000 every 2s for 10s (Wowhead normal report; guide total says 125000)

conflicts: Exact count and mode scaling are absent from the repository; old Icy content is not 4.4.2 Classic evidence.

mechanics.summary: Mangle is applied to the current victim/current tank by the repository target filter; the current guides describe a defensive 30-second tank event.
conflicts: Current Wowhead/Icy report 1-minute Sweltering Armor; Warcraft Tavern reports 2 minutes; spell duration is not audited here.

mechanics.summary: Mangle transitions to a Crash that stops normal boss movement and ejects pincer passengers; raid evades the damage/stun and then mounts.
conflicts: Wowhead narrative and ability-table damage conflict and do not map cleanly to 10/25; exact mode damage is unresolved.

mechanics.summary: Repository has two pincer body parts, selects a free pincer for mounting, and triggers impale only after both hook auras are on one target.

values.guide_mount_players: up to 2 (current Wowhead/Icy); Warcraft Tavern says 3 melee
values.repository_hook_condition: both hook auras on same target

conflicts: Current and historical strategy sources disagree on two versus three players and exact click timing; repository vehicle topology supports two but does not prove retail interaction tolerance.

mechanics.summary: Successful impale exposes the head; current guides report a 30-second +100% damage vulnerability window and then the normal phase repeats.
Heroic engage summons Nefarian; Blazing Inferno creates a fire hazard and Bone Constructs, while Shadow Breath is scheduled after Magmaw drops below 30%.

values.shadow_breath_guide: roughly 27000 to random target and nearby players within 5yd

conflicts: Repository Shadow Breath selection (two targets, non-vehicle) does not by itself establish the guide's splash semantics or exact 1-second cadence; all heroic timer/damage values require live confirmation.

repository_audit.finding: RAID_MODE spell IDs are ordered 10N, 25N, 10H, 25H for Parasite/Mangle damage macros.
Engage schedules 6s projectile, 19s Spew, 90s Mangle; projectile cadence is 6s with a Pillar after four, Spew repeats 24s, Mangle repeats 95s, and Mangle prepares/executes Crash.
Heroic threshold, Nefarian events, Spit size targets, Mangle victim filtering, Pillar >15-yard preference, two-hook impale, and max-three Parasite debuff hotfix comment are implemented.
BWD has six encounter slots; Magmaw data is slot 0, creature IDs include boss/pincers/heads/Nefarian/constructs, and generic Massive Crash damage spell ID is 88287.
Instance maps Magmaw and heroic Nefarian data, ties the inner chamber door to Magmaw, forwards summons, and cleans Crash dummies/stalkers on FAIL/DONE while notifying generic Nefarius on DONE.
AddSC_boss_magmaw is declared and invoked by the Eastern Kingdoms loader.
Historical 4.3.4 templates/difficulty entries and instance encounter 1024 exist for Magmaw/heads; this is not a current 4.4.2 SQL snapshot.

The old world snapshot has map 669 access rows for modes 0/1/2/3 (10N/25N/10H/25H), instance_template map 669 script instance_blackwing_descent, and instance_encounters (1024,0,41570,0,'Magmaw'); it contains no 4.4.2 retail tuning proof.

lifecycle.engage: BossAI engage, encounter frame engage, parasite world state reset, combat phase; heroic summons Nefarian.
lifecycle.mangle_to_impale: Mangle cancels projectile/Spew; Crash ejects pincer passengers; both hook auras trigger ACTION_IMPALE_MAGMAW; head is exposed after the impale sequence.
lifecycle.evade: FAIL; eject boss/pincers; remove Parasite Infection/Vomit; despawn head/summons/Nefarian; instance removes Crash dummies and room stalkers.
lifecycle.death: Remove parasite auras, disengage encounter frames, tell Nefarian to finish, call BossAI::_JustDied; instance DONE cleanup and generic Nefarius progression notification.
lifecycle.retail_credit_status: Repository state/credit only; retail loot, achievement, and exact reset persistence are unresolved.

unresolved.detail: Patch 4.4.2 notes establish the version/date but contain no Magmaw tuning; original Cataclysm hotfixes are not proof of Classic carryover.

Guide health figures are source-only; Crash prose/table and ability ranges do not provide a reliable 10N/10H/25N/25H mapping.

Current Wowhead/Icy say 1m, Warcraft Tavern says 2m; script confirms application/removal but not spell duration.
